_schema_note: One line per (configuration,id,source). RMH has two codebook elements, so each line carries elements.RMH-A and elements.RMH-B (mentions, want, rejects, match_level, derived code_minority/code_majority per codebook s.5). Top-level wants = both elements wants; code = derived code against the MINORITY map for the configuration (3 if either element opposes, else 2 if either supports, else 4, else 1, else 0; if one element is 2 and the other 3 the RMH-B code is used and the note says mixed); code_majority = same against the majority map.
